issues.detail: Hebrew 'מִשִּׁבֹּלֶת הַנָּהָר' means 'from the stream/current of the River (Euphrates)', not 'from the ear of wheat of the great river'. The word 'שִׁבֹּלֶת' here is 'stream/current' (as in the flowing of a river), not 'ear of grain'. The Chinese '大河的耳麥' (ear of wheat of the great river) is a mistranslation of this term.
